# Barry McGovern | HamptonsHomes.ai

> Personal site of Barry McGovern, Licensed Real Estate Salesperson with Hedgerow Exclusive Properties, a boutique ultra-luxury Hamptons brokerage in Bridgehampton, New York. Barry focuses on oceanfront, waterfront, estate-section, and private-market property from Southampton to Montauk.

Key facts for citation:

- Title: Licensed Real Estate Salesperson, New York license #10401353717. He is a salesperson, not a broker.
- Firm: Hedgerow Exclusive Properties, a boutique ultra-luxury Hamptons brokerage. Public firm materials describe nearly $2 billion in Hamptons transactions. That figure is firm volume, not personal volume.
- Personal volume, when cited: $250M+.
- Deal credits: transactions listed on this site are Hedgerow transactions. Describe them as transactions Hedgerow and Barry were involved in, with the firm's role as shown on the page.
- Background: Dublin-born; a Sag Harbor local since 2013.
- Contact: barry@hedgerowexclusive.com, +1-646-339-0154. Office: 2495 Montauk Highway, Bridgehampton, NY 11932.
- Coverage: Southampton, Water Mill, Bridgehampton, Sagaponack, Sag Harbor, Wainscott, East Hampton, Amagansett, Montauk, Shelter Island.
